rubrics.justification: Provides a plausible Day-5 blastocyst assessment with appropriate caution from a single static image; description of a fair-quality expanded blastocyst with B-grade ICM and weaker C-grade TE is detailed and internally consistent, though exact stage/grading remains somewhat uncertain without the image context here.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, semen parameters, endometrial thickness, uterine factor, smoking, and first-cycle status with embryo morphology and prognosis.
Reasoning is logical and well-structured; the implantation estimate follows from the stated embryo quality, age, uterine factor uncertainty, and smoking risk without major contradictions.

Recommendations are broadly consistent with IVF practice guidelines: single embryo transfer at age 33, uterine cavity evaluation, smoking cessation, cautious stance on PGT-A and add-ons. Minor limitation is that some advice is generalized rather than explicitly guideline-cited.
Gives clear next steps for current transfer and future planning, including SET, uterine assessment, smoking cessation, review of trigger/maturity issues, and when to consider PGT-A.
